Samira Khan: FinanceBot just sent an alert: GPU spend for project=helios-prod spiked to $18,500/day yesterday which exceeds our $10k/day soft budget. can infra confirm whether this is customer load or internal runs? :eyes:
FinanceBot: Alert: Project helios-prod daily GPU spend exceeded threshold (185% of budget) on 2026-08-04. Top SKUs: a100-80gb on-demand. Billing export: https://console.cloud/billing/exports/helios-2026-08-04.csv
Oliver Reed: looking now 1: i see a burst of on-demand A100s from 02:10-04:40 UTC. owner_tag shows app-worker@helios but job_label includes "nightly-batch". need to know if nightly-batch is scheduled customer processing or an internal maintenance job.
Jenny Park: that nightly-batch was recently switched to run heavier ML-eval workloads by the ML team. we intended it to run on staging GPUs but a deploy changed the environment var to production. i've reverted the deploy but historical charges remain.
Samira Khan: ok. finance needs a CSV with lineItemIds + usage windows + job_id so we can file a vendor case and propose a chargeback to ML-team project. also want a short description for the vendor case.
Oliver Reed: running a query to map billing rows to job metadata. here's the BigQuery snippet i used to get job-level costs:
```
SELECT
  invoice_month,
  labels.owner AS owner,
  labels.job_label AS job_label,
  job_metadata.job_id,
  sku_description,
  SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM `company_billing.gcp_billing_export_v1_*` b
LEFT JOIN `infra.job_metadata.jobs` job_metadata
  ON b.resource_id = job_metadata.instance_id
WHERE DATE(b.usage_start_time) = '2026-08-04'
  AND LOWER(sku_description) LIKE '%a100%'
GROUP BY invoice_month, owner, job_label, job_id, sku_description
ORDER BY total_cost DESC;
```
Oliver Reed: will export CSV to /shared/finance-temp/helios-nightly-20260804.csv in a few mins.
FinanceBot: Note: billing export processed at 2026-09-01T04:00:00Z. Recommendation: open vendor support case with lineItemIds and request reallocation or credit where internal runs were billed to production. Also suggest a short-term soft quota for nightly-batch in prod.
Marcus Li: finance: provisional approval for a chargeback to ML-team pending CSV + manager sign-off from ML lead. final approval after vendor response. also +1 to soft quota until tagging/enforcement is done.
Jenny Park: pushed a hotfix to the deploy template to ensure NIGHTLY_ENV maps to staging for eval jobs. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ml/pull/1102. i'll also add a preflight check to prevent prod env for nightly-batch.
Samira Khan: please also add an alert rule: when a single job_label accumulates > $8k GPU cost in 24h in prod, notify #billing-alerts + ml-team. want to catch runaway config changes earlier.
Oliver Reed: added the alert draft in ops-monitoring: channel=#billing-alerts, window=24h, threshold=$8k by job_label. will push after finance ack.
Samira Khan: ack. Jenny/Oliver please drop the CSV link here when ready and include run_owner + job_id column so i can file the vendor case with legal cc'd. thanks all. :thumbsup:
